description: Stargazing forecast (US) — Best nights and hours to see the stars at a US location: NOAA/NWS hourly sky cover, precip chance, visibility and temperature combined with an offline sun and moon ephemeris (astronomical darkness, moon altitude and illumination). Each night gets a 0-100 score, a rating EXCELLENT/GOOD/FAIR/POOR/CLOUDED OUT, the longest clear dark window, moon phase and the best hour, plus an overall GO/MAYBE/NO-GO. lat+lon or place; optional nights=1-6 (default 3), max_sky=0-100 cloud-cover limit (default 30), hours=true for the hourly rows. Example: /v1/weather/stargazing?lat=31.96&lon=-111.60&nights=5 Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: weather_stargazing
